title: Parts Master / Inventory
description: One record per part number: how many we have, at which of our locations, what it costs, what we sell it for, and how fast it moves.
x-sap-analogue: MARA/MARC/MBEW (material master, plant data, valuation) combined
x-api-note: CDK documents an Async Parts Inventory API for bulk extract, but real-time single-part-number lookup and full valuation-field schema are thinner than the RO/customer APIs.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.
